index.p--tucked-between-palm-forest-and-: Tucked between palm forest and the Indian Ocean, Light House Surf Camp is a hideaway for those who want their adventure with a side of serenity. Our timber and thatch cabanas rise naturally from the jungle, our natural-wood restaurant frames the sunset, and the surf is never more than a barefoot stroll away.
index.p--it-is-the-rare-place-where: It is the rare place where you can chase barrels at dawn, practise yoga at noon, and watch the stars from a hammock by night — all without leaving home.

index.p--travelled-solo-and-never-felt-a: "Travelled solo and never felt alone. Sunset from the hammock, surf, yoga, a safari, the freshest seafood. Pure magic on the east coast."

index.p--peak-surf-season-runs-june-to: Peak surf season runs June to October, when the swell is most consistent and the bay is at its best. Our cabanas are limited and fill first for those months, so book early. Outside the peak the coast is quieter, greener and ideal if you are learning.
index.button--i-have-never-surfed-before: I have never surfed before. Is this camp for me?+
index.p--yes-most-of-our-guests-arrive: Yes — most of our guests arrive as complete beginners. Lessons run in small groups with certified local coaches, and we read the swell each morning to pick a break that suits your level. Soft-tops and rash guards are provided.

index.button--what-is-included-in-an-all: What is included in an all-inclusive camp?+
index.p--your-cabana-every-meal-your-coa: Your cabana, every meal, your coached surf sessions and your board hire — all in one price. Longer camps add Ayurvedic treatments, video coaching and surf-safari trips up the coast. The full list sits on each package card above.

about.h1--born-on-this-coast-made-for:
Born on this coast.
Made for surfers.
about.p--light-house-surf-camp-is-a: Light House Surf Camp is a local-run camp in Arugam Bay, built by surfers who grew up reading these waves. We share the breaks we love with travellers from all over the world.
about.h2--a-surf-camp-with-local-soul: A surf camp with local soul.
about.p--arugam-bay-is-more-than-a: Arugam Bay is more than a destination to us — it's home. We grew up surfing Main Point, learning the moods of Pottuvil and discovering hidden gems like the Light House break at Sangamankanda. After the war, as surfers from around the world began discovering this paradise, we wanted to share it the right way: with genuine local knowledge, real care, and warm Sri Lankan hospitality.
about.p--today-we-run-surf-lessons-all: Today we run surf lessons, all-inclusive camps, board rentals and coaching for everyone from first-timers to advanced surfers — and we handle the whole trip, from airport pick-up to your last sunset session.
about.p--we-know-every-break-tide-and: We know every break, tide and swell window on this coast — so you always surf the right wave at the right time.
about.p--small-classes-patient-coaching-: Small classes, patient coaching and a genuine investment in your progress. You're a guest, not a number.
about.p--certified-coaches-quality-gear-: Certified coaches, quality gear and careful spot selection mean you can push your limits with confidence.
about.p--local-food-local-breaks-local-s: Local food, local breaks, local stories. We share the real Arugam Bay, beyond just the waves.
about.p--we-surf-and-travel-lightly-eco: We surf and travel lightly — eco-friendly lagoon trips, clean beaches and respect for the wildlife around us.
about.p--from-comfortable-stays-to-seaml: From comfortable stays to seamless logistics, we deliver a polished surf holiday at honest prices.
about.p--surfing-is-the-heart-of-it: Surfing is the heart of it, but Arugam Bay has so much more. We organise Kumana National Park safaris, Pottuvil lagoon canoe trips, visits to ancient temples like Muhudu Maha Viharaya, sunset hikes up Elephant Rock, yoga, fishing trips and nights out on the buzzing main street.
